verses.text: Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha tiknaik a hachxo ol a tzey chab'ok k'een k'een, icha wal k'een ix wak' t'ayach t'a sb'ab'elal, haton k'een ix a mak'pojok. Ol in tz'ib'anxioch t'a k'een, icha wal tas ix in tz'ib'ejoch t'a k'een b'ab'el chi'.
Tza b'oan a b'a t'a k'inhib'alil k'ik'an, tzach jawi t'a wichanh t'a jolom witz tik.
Malaj junok mach syal sk'eta het'ok, malaj junok mach syal yek' t'a spatiktak lum witz tik. Max yalpaxlaj yek' nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax wael t'a yichtak lu'um, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi, ix stzeyan chab' k'een k'een winh icha k'een ix scha' t'a sb'ab'elal t'a Jehová. Haxo t'a k'inhib'alil t'a junxo k'u, ix yik'anb'at k'een winh, ix b'at winh t'a jolom witz Sinaí, icha wal ix yutej Jehová yalan t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix emul Jehová t'a stz'ey winh t'a skal asun t'a jolom witz chi', ix yalan sb'i t'a winh.

Ix ek'b'at Jehová t'a yichanh winh, te chaanh ix yal icha tik: --Ha in ton Jehová in. Jehová in b'i. Te wach' in k'ool, tz'ok' in k'ol t'a anima. Manh elanhchamelok skot wowal. Te niwan tzin xajanej heb' anima, swak'nhejelk'och tas swala'.

Ha tas wach' walnakkan t'a heb' he mam eyicham, ol wak'nhejelk'och t'ayex a ex yinhtilexkan heb' tik t'a masanil tiempo. Swak'an niwank'olal he chukal he mul yet' he pital. Palta max ek'b'atlaj wak'an syaelal junok mach yuj smul b'aj junelnhej pit syutej sb'a t'ayin, swak'nhejkan yaelal t'a yib'anh yuninal yet' yixchikin, masanto t'a schanhil makan yinhtilal, xchi Jehová.
T'a elanhchamel ix em nhojan winhaj Moisés chi', ix emk'och snanhal sat winh t'a sat lu'um t'a yichanh Jehová chi', ix yalan winh icha tik:
--Mamin Wajalil, tato yel tzach tzalaj wet'ok, tzach b'atnhej ket'ok, wach'chom a jun chonhab' tik te pit, palta ak' niwank'olal ko chukal tz'och t'a ichanh, tzonh a chaankan a chonhab'ok, xchi winh.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Chaab' tas ol wala': Ha tiknaik, tzin b'okan jun in trato tik t'a yichanh masanil heb' etchonhab'. Ol in b'o tastak te satub'tak to mantalaj b'aj tzuji t'a junokxo nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ol yil masanil heb' etchonhab' heb' ajun tik het'ok tastak ol in k'ulej eyuuj, to satub'tak yilji.
k'anab'ajejek masanil tas swalkan tik t'ayex. Ha in ol wik'el heb' amorreo, heb' cananeo, heb' hitita, heb' ferezeo, heb' heveo yet' heb' jebuseo t'a eyichanh.
Ayik ol ex k'och t'a sat lum lum chi', malajokab' b'ak'inh tze b'o junok he trato yet' heb' anima ta'. Tato skan heb' t'a he kal, yel ol ex yixtejel heb'.
Ha wal tas ol he k'ulej to ol he mak'poj yaltar heb' yet' yechel sdiosal heb'. Tze ch'akanel te te' yechel sdiosal heb' skuchan Asera.
Manh ex lesalwok t'a junok komon Dios, yujto a in Jehová in, yelxo wal te ow in t'a juntzanh chi'. Yelxo wal ste kot wowal t'ayex tato tzex och ejmelal t'a junok ch'ok diosal.

Manh he b'olaj junok he trato yet' heb' anima ayek' t'a sat lum chi'. Tato tze b'o he trato chi' yet' heb' haxo yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a sdiosal chi', syak'an silab' heb' t'ay, tzex yawtej heb', tze waan tas syak' heb' silab'ok chi'.

Talaj syik'laj sb'a yisil heb' yet' heb' eyuninal, haxo yik tz'em nhojan heb' ix t'a sdiosal chi', skuchb'ajem nhojan heb' eyuninal chi' yuj heb' ix t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi'. Tato icha chi' manhxalaj tz'aj welk'och t'a yol sat heb' eyuninal chi'.
Manh he b'o junok he diosal yet' k'een k'een sb'ochaj t'a molde.

Tze yak'och k'inh yik ixim pan malaj yich. Uke' k'ual tze wa jun pan chi', icha wal ix aj wak'an he k'ayb'ej. Ha stiempoal, chekel yajkani, haton uj Abib, yujto ha t'a jun uj chi' elnakexkot t'a Egipto.
Masanil heb' b'ab'el winak unin, wik yaj heb'. Wikpax sb'ab'el yune' nok' he wakax, yune' nok' he kalnel yet' yune' nok' he chiwa tato winak.

Haxo pax sb'ab'el yune' nok' he b'uru, syal yak'ji junok yune' kalnel sk'exulok nok'. Tato malaj junok sk'exul nok' tzeyak'a', yowalil smak'ji k'ichaj sjaj nok'. Hanheja' pax yuj he b'ab'el winak unin, yowalil tzeyak' junok nok' yune' kalnel sk'exulok. Malaj junok mach sja t'ayin t'a k'inh tato malaj jab'ok yofrenda yet'nak.
T'a wake' k'ual tzex munlaji, haxo t'a yukil k'ual tzeyik'an eyip, wach'chom stiempoal munlajel, ma stiempoal smolchajk'e sat eyawb'en, yowalil tzeyik' eyip.
Tzeyak'och k'inh yik sb'ab'el sat ixim he trigo sk'anb'i, haton k'inh Pentecostés. Tzeyak'anpaxoch junxo k'inh yik slajwik'e ixim yik lajwub' ab'il.
Masanil heb' winak, yowalil oxel sjawi heb' t'a wichanh t'a yol junjun ab'il t'a juntzanh k'inh tik, a in Jehová he Diosal in tik swala'.
Ol wik'el masanil juntzanhxo nación t'a eyichanh, ol wak' lewanb'ok he lu'um. Malaj mach syal yik'anek' lum he lu'um chi', yakb'an ayek' heb' winak t'a wichanh oxel t'a yol ab'il.

Ayik tzeyak'an he silab' t'ayin, manh eyak' schik'il nok' nok' yet' ixim pan ayb'at yich t'a skal. Ha nok' silab' yik jun k'inh yik tze naankoti ayik ex wik'annakelta t'a Egipto, tato ayto nok' skani, manh he sik'kanb'at t'a junxo k'u.
Ha sb'ab'el sat eyawb'en yowalil tzeyik'kot t'a in kajnub'. Manh he tz'anh nok' yunetak chiwa t'a skal yal yim snun, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': Tz'ib'ej masanil juntzanh lolonel tik, yujto a ayoch yichb'anelok in trato ix wak' het'ok yet' pax heb' etchonhab', xchi.

Ha winhaj Moisés chi', 40 k'ual yet' 40 ak'wal ix ek' winh yet' Jehová t'a jolom witz Sinaí. Malaj wal jab'ok tas ix swa winh, malaj pax jab'ok tas ix yuk'ej winh t'a jun pekti' chi'. Ix stz'ib'anoch slolonelal strato Jehová yet' heb' chonhab' israel t'a k'een k'een, haton lajunhe' cheknab'il.

Ixlajwi chi, ix emixta winhaj Moisés chi' t'a jolom witz Sinaí chi', yet'nakxopax chab' pachanh k'een k'een winh, haton k'een b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch cheknab'il chi'. Manh yojtakok winh tato toxonhej sweei yilji sat, yujto ix lolon winh yet' Jehová.
Haxo ix yilan winhaj Aarón yet' masanil heb' yetchonhab' to toxonhej sweei yilji sat winh, ix te xiwk'e heb' smasanil sk'och t'a stz'ey winh.
Ix yawtankot heb' anima chi' winh, ichato chi' ix snitzanoch sb'a winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' t'a stz'ey winh, ix lolon winh t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix snitzankot sb'a masanil heb' chonhab', ix och ijan winh yalan masanil cheknab'il ix yak' Jehová t'a winh, haton juntzanh ix b'at schaemta winh t'a jolom witz Sinaí chi'.
Ha ix lajwi slolon winh t'a heb' anima chi', ix smakan sat winh t'a jun k'apak.
Haxo yik tz'och winh yik slolon yet' Jehová, syik'el jun k'apak chi' winh. Haxo tz'elxul winh, syalanxi winh t'a heb' chonhab' tas cheknab'ilal schek Jehová chi' yal t'a heb'.

Ayik wan slolon winh t'a heb' chi', syilan heb' to weei yilji sat winh. Slajwi yalan scheknab'il Jehová winh t'a heb', smakanxi sat winh t'a jun k'apak chi'. Hato yik tz'och winh lolonel t'a yichanh Jehová, syik'anxiel winh.
